evidence.observation: Reads ~443-446 °C, physically implausible for a reboiler at 500 mbar with column temps 63-75 °C; slowly drifting upward
Sustained oscillation of several °C with ~13 min period, no damping
Top/condenser temps frozen at 63.3/63.9/63.4 °C, essentially flat all run
Pressure and dP stable (~500 mbar, 0.6/2.8 mbar), no flooding or blockage
